title: Untangle environment overlays and introduce provider-compat migration assistant
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Our current environment overlay pattern has accumulated ad-hoc patches across >12 workspaces, making provider upgrades and small networking changes high-risk (frequent terraform tainting, long apply times, and manual drift fixes).

Goal: Replace the brittle overlay concatenation with an environment-abstracted networking module surface and a provider-compat shim layer. Ship an automated migration assistant (terraform-run wrapper + CI job) that performs safe, validated state transitions and can roll back when needed.

Scope:
- Introduce a single "env-networking" module that standardizes subnet/NAT/EIP lifecycle and exposes a stable interface per environment (dev/stage/prod).
- Implement provider-compat shims to allow AWS provider 5.x and 6.x in parallel during migration windows.
- Build a migration assistant that: plans with -refresh, runs drift checks, creates state snapshot, executes targeted state moves when validated, and posts results to PR.

Non-goals: Full rework of IAM or cross-account networking ownership (separate ticket).

Success criteria:
- Able to upgrade AWS provider from 3.x -> 6.x in a stage workspace without manual state surgery.
- Cut PRs that move overlay-based resources into env-networking with automated plan + approval checks.
- Reduce average terraform apply time for networking changes by 35% in dev and 20% in stage.
- No customer-impacting networking incidents during staged rollout (monitoring and rollback verified).

Testing & Validation:
- Create a matrix of 6 representative workspaces and run the migration assistant in dry-run mode.
- End-to-end smoke tests in ephemeral envs (GH Actions job infra/migration-e2e).
- Post-migration cost/latency benchmarks for routes dependent on NAT/EIP behavior.
steps: Design: finalize env-networking module interface (subnet_counts, nat_strategy, eip_lifecycle) - RFC posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ENV-NETWORKING-2025
Shim: implement provider_compat module that selects provider alias based on workspace metadata and pins behavior tests
Assistant: create migration assistant script + GH Action (infra/migration-assistant) with plan-review-apply flow
Pilot: migrate two non-critical stage workspaces, validate smoke tests and run rollback drills
Rollout: staggered migration across remaining workspaces with 48h observation windows and automatic rollback triggers
